title: Elvis and Eminem Just Sued an AI Music Company. Every Creator Should Read Why.
yt_title: Elvis and Eminem v. Suno: What the AI Music Suits Mean

slides.label: The suits
slides.text: On *Nov 6*, *Elvis Presley Enterprises* and Eminem co-publisher *Eight Mile Style* sued *Suno* in federal court.

slides.label: The claim
slides.text: They say Suno trained its AI on their songs *without permission*. The Eminem case covers *269 songs*.

slides.label: The big test
slides.text: The Elvis case invokes Tennessee's *ELVIS Act*, which protects an artist's *voice and likeness*.

slides.label: Suno's side
slides.text: Suno says it *blocks* prompts naming artists and screens uploads. These are *allegations*, not findings.

slides.label: Creators
slides.text: *Read the terms* before you upload. Protect raw vocals. *Register* your work. Document soundalikes.

cta_line: Your catalog is an asset. *Treat it like one.*
